text:
alex: FYI from today's Acme sync 1: they want SSO + auditability in the MVP. hard ask tied to their pilot contract.

maya: Wait, they asked for auditability in MVP? that's new. do we have the time?

alex: Yup. they gave an earlier ship targetend of next quarter which moves our milestone ~3w earlier.

sam: SSO core is doable w/ OIDC passthrough. audit logs is riskier (retention, export, compliance). my gut: split phased promise.

sylvia: Agree. Audit logs touches retention policies + long-term storage. needs legal + compliance review.

sam: Two proposal cutlists (very quick):
A) "MVP-lite": auth + SSO passthrough only. keeps current timeline.
B) "MVP-with-basic-logs": auth + SSO + basic audit logs (30d retention, simple export) -> +3w, infra delta, compliance signoff.

sam: Tech delta sketch:
```
infra: +1 db shard, +1 retention-store instance
cost: ~+$8k/mo (infra+ops)
work: +3w eng + compliance review
```

maya: If Acme signs LOI we can consider timeline reset. if not, offer phased promise: SSO in MVP, audit logs early v1 after paid commit.

sylvia: If we do timeline reset, we should select non-customer-facing items to trade (UX polish, advanced telemetry, internal infra refactors).

alex: Action: @sam post full cutlist (A/B) with time/cost/risk by EOD. @alex confirm exact Acme asks + LOI timing and share. reconvene tomorrow 10:30am PT to decide.

dev-bot: Deploy note: auth-service canary 2025-09-21 03:00 UTC 1 - check for breaking changes when cutting features.

maya: +1. also add a quick customer impact blurb for sales so they can negotiate the LOI terms (we need commitment to pay for audit infra).

sam: I'll include SLA/cost bullets.

sylvia: Also flag legal data residency constraints for Acme's region.

alex: Good catch. We'll surface that in the trade document. meeting tomorrow 10:30. :thumbsup:
